criteria.statement: The deployment wizard has a distinct public-route step where an operator selects an Arcana hostname, target port, health path, and managed HTTPS, or explicitly leaves the deployment private.
Preview returns the exact non-secret DNS, tunnel, proxy, TLS, provider configuration hash, ordered apply operations, and rollback operations included in the canonical signed desired-state hash.
Hostname syntax, managed-zone ownership, protected-zone policy, collisions, allowed/exposed target ports, upstream scheme, and TLS expectations fail closed before mutation.

The production adapter uses the Cloudflare API for remote-managed tunnel ingress and proxied DNS without shell-editing nginx, connector, or Cloudflare configuration files; credentials remain server-side.
Application apply and health precede route publication; provider mutations compensate on route/TLS failure and the prior application desired state is restored when available.
A successful full flow verifies an HTTPS 2xx response at the intended hostname before marking the direct-runtime deployment run successful.

A signed service/route-attach request for an existing deployed service creates a policy-checked intent whose desired hash includes the route and executes routing plus HTTPS verification without artifact convergence.
